overview.description: The American Century Large Cap Growth ETF (ACGR) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is an actively managed, non-transparent ETF that selects US large-cap growth stocks based on positive fundamentals and ESG criteria. ACGR was launched on Jun 29, 2021 and is issued by American Century Investments.

holdings.infoBox: ACGR is an equity ETF with a total of 82 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 13.62%, Microsoft at 10.30%, Apple at 9.63%, Alphabet at 7.54%, and Broadcom at 6.52%.
